## 2. Production Shipped Systems (v1.0.0+)
### OpenMail (/projects/openmail/)
- Category: Email & Communication Infrastructure
- Status: Stable Release (v1.0.0, 2026-09-10)
- Stack: Go, SQLite, integrated SMTP/IMAP, ACME automated TLS
- Architecture: Single-binary monolithic mail engine with local-first data ownership, zero vendor telemetry, DKIM/SPF/DMARC tooling.
- Repository: https://github.com/eshanized/OpenMail

### Mercura (/projects/mercura/)
- Category: Developer Infrastructure / VCS Forge
- Status: Stable Release (v1.0.0, 2026-09-11)
- Stack: Go, Mercurial, Tree-sitter
- Architecture: Local-first code intelligence, fast repository exploration, AST indexing.
- Repository: https://tonmoyinfrastructure.org/projects/mercura/

### M31A (/projects/m31a/)
- Category: Autonomous Software Engineering Runtime
- Status: Stable Release (v0.1.1, 2026-09-12)
- Stack: Rust (single crate), Terminal Cockpit, non-bypassable policy gates
- Architecture: Verifiable autonomous execution with strict capability sandboxing and step-by-step verification ledger.
- Dedicated Host: https://m31a.tonmoyinfrastructure.org/

### Octate (/projects/octate/)
- Category: Developer Tooling / Code Review CLI
- Status: Stable Release (v1.0.0, 2026-09-13)
- Stack: TypeScript, Node.js, Tree-sitter WASM, React / Ink, SARIF v2.1.0
- Architecture: Terminal-native AI code review combining deterministic AST intelligence, cross-file reference graphs, multi-stage LLM review DAGs, and a two-stage critic gate.
- npm: @tiverse/octate
- Repository: https://github.com/vedanthq/Octate

## 3. Experimental AI Models & Research Checkpoints
### M31Genesis (/projects/m31genesis/)
- Parameter Count: 425M-class decoder-only transformer
- Training: High-quality code and structured reasoning tokens
- Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/eshanized/M31Genesis

### M31Tesla (/projects/m31tesla/)
- Parameter Count: 228.9M parameters
- Architecture: 20 layers, 896 hidden dimension, Grouped-Query Attention (GQA), RoPE embeddings
- Task: Autonomous Python code repair runtime
- Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/eshanized/M31Tesla

### M31Entropy (/projects/m31entropy/)
- Parameter Count: 314M parameters
- Architecture: 128k vocabulary density exploration transformer
- Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/eshanized/M31Entropy
